summary: Iteration 37: tested 4 SNC v2 enhancements (Sample Buttons, Safety Recommend Override, Email My Report, Growth Wins Dashboard Card). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_snc2_enhancements.py with 11 targeted tests — all pass. Regression: all 50 existing SNC v2 tests (test_snc2.py=12, test_snc2_api.py=11, test_snc2_comparison.py=9, test_snc2_compare_api.py=18) still pass — the iteration-36 _latest_safety_level fix is intact. Frontend verified in Chromium: dashboard-snc-highlights card renders on /dashboard for parent1 with 86% aligned with Riley Parent, 3 highlight rows (data-testid dashboard-highlight-0..2), and click navigates to /special-needs-v2/compare/snc2_share_a8d0dccb74cc. snc2-samples-block on /special-needs-v2 (verified with fresh user because parent1 has an in-progress assessment) shows 3 sample links with correct /downloads/snc-sample-*.pdf hrefs and target=_blank. snc2-report-email button present on report page next to Download PDF / Regenerate / Co-Parent Compare and click triggers success (Resend accepted, body contained parent1@test.com).

issues: Legal Acknowledgment modal AND a 1/6 Welcome/Orientation slideshow both intercept the dashboard on first visit — Skip button on /orientation left the app at /orientation instead of /dashboard; had to explicit-goto /dashboard for card verification. Not a functional bug, but adds three barriers before the dashboard for a returning parent.

critical_code_review_comments: snc2_routes.py::_is_stale correctly compares report.safety_level_at_generation against the current latest safety_level — cache invalidates as expected. Good defensive check.

snc2_report_content.py::_s9_recommended_structure hard-override logic uses an ordered map {cooperative:0, structured:1, parallel_or_supported:2} and only escalates upward via `order[required] > order[rec]`. Correct: cannot silently downgrade a safety-driven recommendation to cooperative.

snc2_comparison_routes.py::dashboard_highlights swallows HTTPException from _load_comparison (for non-ready shares) and iterates to the next active share — good ergonomics for the Growth Wins card. Also correctly returns the empty payload when the viewer is safety-blocked (verified with L1 assessment).

email_service.send_snc_report_pdf: verified end-to-end via Resend (200 accepted, actual delivery not asserted). Endpoint returns 503 (with friendly detail) when RESEND_API_KEY is missing — good failure-mode isolation.

The Dashboard onboarding chain (legal modal + orientation slideshow + potential guest-claim modal) is heavy for a returning user. Consider persisting orientation-seen and skipping the slideshow on subsequent logins.

There is no DELETE endpoint for safety_assessments — tests still have to reach into pymongo (documented pattern from iteration 36). Consider adding a self-service DELETE for the parent's own latest safety_assessment.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (highlights card, sample buttons, email button all verified)

test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123! (Sam Parent), parent2@test.com / TestPass123! (Riley Parent). Ephemeral TEST_* users are used for guardrail/edge scenarios and cleaned up.

Safety assessments used for override tests are deleted after each test via direct pymongo. Autouse module cleanup also purges lingering safety records for parent1@test.com.
